scope: Offline tokenizer audit of unchanged production classifier and judge question heads over 24 public cohort cases, 48 captured requests, 1248 questions. Does not execute model inference or measure accuracy. Captures first classifier ask only; includes judge questions generated from ranked frozen primary evidence. Does not include replay alternate calls or non-cohort admission contexts.
method: Capture production classifier and judge ask request, then immediately throw before model inference; 24 public cohort cases; primary frozen evidence rank; typed empty context; instantiate local cached tokenizer; use production Laya render_options and build_head; independently reconstruct truncation and assert token IDs match build_head on every question. Instruction counts include type and literal question prefix; option counts exclude MASK; head includes CLS, SEP and MASK special tokens.

calibrationNote.interpretation: This specific clamped bucket is unused in the captured cohort. Existing Jev admission and verdict probability thresholds were reused unchanged and are not independently calibrated for Laya.

findings: Every choice option is capped at 48 text tokens first. When total option cost leaves fewer than 16 head tokens, each option is clipped again to max(4, floor((192-16)/option_count)) including its MASK.
Instructions are prefix-clipped to max(8, remaining option budget); long trailing safety, scope and evidential-basis rules can be absent even when usage.truncated is false.

usage.truncated and truncated_questions in this Laya server track state truncation, not question head clipping. Adapter truncatedAsks metrics therefore cannot establish the complete question was retained.
The configured head_max_len is a budget before three CLS/SEP overhead tokens: actual head size can reach 195. No adaptation or prompt shortening was applied in this baseline.

representativePublicQuestionExamples.question: e0_scope
representativePublicQuestionExamples.instructionRetainedText: noul question: Does retained evidence ev-46f616d3adef209f6710 address the same referent, factual relation and material time, place and population circumstances as the proposition without guessing? Assess scope separately from agreement: a different asserted value, location or date can directly refute the claim and is not itself a scope mismatch. For example, evidence naming a different capital of the same country addresses the same relation; evidence about another country, period or population does not. An in-scope counterexample can refute a universal claim; a limited sample cannot substantiate a universal claim about all places, times or people.
